label: Стоять
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for стоять (to stand).

missions.phrase: Я стою у окна и жду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Стою' is the 1sg form of стоять; the -ять infinitive still takes i-type endings, here -ю. 'У окна' marks the spot and 'жду' adds a second action.

missions.phrase: Ты стоишь слишком близко к двери.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Стоишь' shows the -ишь ending of стоять. 'Слишком близко к двери' makes a natural everyday remark about position.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Стоит' is the core -ит form of стоять. 'Прямо перед домом' fixes a static location with no movement.

missions.phrase: Мы стоим в очереди уже час.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Стоим' carries the -им plural ending of стоять. 'В очереди уже час' gives a very common waiting situation.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Стоите' trains the -ите form of стоять. 'На самом краю' makes an urgent warning useful in real speech.

missions.phrase: Дети стоят и смотрят на небо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Стоят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending of стоять. 'Смотрят на небо' adds a parallel verb in the same form.

missions.phrase: Вчера он долго стоял под дождём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Стоял' is the masculine singular past of стоять with the -л suffix. 'Под дождём' and 'долго' set the scene vividly.

missions.phrase: Она стояла у окна и плакала.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Стояла' adds the feminine -ла ending of стоять. The parallel 'плакала' shows the same past pattern on a second verb.

missions.phrase: Мы будем стоять здесь и ждать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Будем' is the auxiliary and 'стоять' stays in the infinitive, building the compound future. 'Здесь' and 'ждать' frame a patient resolve.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Стой' is the informal command of стоять. 'Спокойно' and 'не двигайся' make a complete, natural instruction to one listener.
